Since \(AB\) is a diameter, the upper semicircle has a central angle of \(180^\circ\).

The unshaded angles to the right of the orange radius total
\[
35^\circ+30^\circ+20^\circ=85^\circ.
\]
Therefore, the shaded sector has angle
\[
180^\circ-85^\circ=95^\circ.
\]

A sector’s area is proportional to its central angle, so the probability is
\[
\frac{95}{360}=\frac{19}{72}.
\]
